intro: Brewmaster Drohn is an orcish brewmaster living just uphill from the bustling port of Ratchet. Having learned the art of exotic fermentation through ties connected to the legendary wandering pandaren Chen Stormstout, Drohn crafts potent beverages on the arid frontier of the Barrens. Adventurers who discover discarded kegs across Kalimdor often find themselves directed straight to his porch.

sections.t: A Master of the Craft in Ratchet
p: Overlooking the goblin docks of Ratchet sits Brewmaster Drohn, an orc who has devoted his craft to the science of brewing rather than simple combat. Brewing from his hillside home, he operates peacefully within the neutral haven established by Gazlowe's Steamwheedle cartel. While most orcs settle for coarse grog or simple spirits, Drohn's work involves rare ingredients, refined balances of flavor, and techniques rarely practiced among his kin.

Drohn's craft is heavily shaped by Chen Stormstout, the famed pandaren wanderer who fought alongside Rexxar and the Horde during the founding of Durotar. Drohn's mentor studied directly under Chen, learning the guarded secrets of Stormstout brews, and Chen himself later instructed Drohn in crafting Trogg Ale. When travelers stumble across Chen's distinct, discarded kegs in the wilds, Drohn is the sole local authority capable of identifying the ingredients and recreating the wanderer's potent concoctions.
